name: sockets_from_shader
description: VI-3a: a pass's input sockets come from its shader's declarations and a drop connects by binding number. On a Blank pipeline project, present draws with engine://passthrough, whose inputs are all variadic: its only socket is the empty end of the variadic band. With a Cube and a Deferred geometry pass, gbuffer_albedo dropped on the band becomes present's input 0 -- a socket of its own inside the band -- and the viewport shows the G-buffer instead of the gradient. A drop on present's heading adds nothing and says where to drop. The author writes a shader with two fixed inputs and picks it in the Pass Editor; binding 1 is an empty socket, and gbuffer_normal dropped on it becomes input 1. The author then deletes binding 1 from the shader: the engine refuses the reload for present, which keeps drawing with its previous shader; the status line names the binding it lost, with Disconnect and Open the shader beside it. Disconnect takes the input out, and the refusal and binding 1's socket go with it.
